recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-39325 unless a future work-group decision changes the allowed Requirements.statement.source requester types.
issue_request: FHIR-39325 was a Published FHIR-core Requirements change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether Requirements.statement.source should allow requesters beyond Practitioner, and the approved resolution changed the allowed target resource types to CareTeam, Device, Group, HealthcareService, Organization, Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and RelatedPerson: all Participant types other than Location.
initial_application: Commit 9771e96b1882c4041a8c5fc2caa48ae7b3f1cb64 explicitly applied FHIR-39325 by replacing the earlier narrower Requirements.statement.source target profile list with the full approved set in source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml.
additional_context: The Requirements resource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source still lists exactly the approved target profiles, later history touching the Requirements StructureDefinition did not remove or reinterpret this allowed-type set, and Jira/community searches found no conflicting later decision for Requirements.statement.source. FHIR-I WGM minutes also record the Persuasive with Mod motion for FHIR-39325.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active StructureDefinition already implements the final Jira decision. No source edit was needed, and adding duplicate narrative or editing generated-looking diagram output would not change implementer understanding.
